research_question: Does per-subject robust normalization improve subject-disjoint wearable stress classification and conformal informativeness in an independently collected Empatica E4 cohort?

dataset.name: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions
dataset.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
dataset.inventory_report: outputs/meno_j_experiment_13_dataset_inventory.json must have inventory_status PASS_PRE_OUTCOME and scientific_outcomes_computed false

excluded_folders.f07: author-documented covered PPG and temperature sensors

primary_cohort.sensitivity_analysis: No excluded subject enters the primary outcome. A future separately frozen sensitivity analysis may examine recoverable segments.

label_contract.self_report_role: Self-reported stress is metadata only and is not substituted for the primary protocol label.

window_contract.selection_method: Generate all non-overlapping windows within each trimmed labeled interval, order chronologically within each class, and choose 16 evenly spaced indices including the endpoints.
window_contract.rationale: The validated inventory guarantees at least 16 stress and 43 non-stress candidates for every primary subject; 30- and 60-second windows do not support a balanced 16-per-class test.

feature_contract.acceleration_units: Convert Empatica ACC integer units to g by dividing by 64 before feature extraction.
feature_contract.checkpoint_policy: One hash-bound NumPy NPZ checkpoint per subject; never modify raw CSV files.

fold_contract.onboarding_use: Unlabeled normalization statistics only; onboarding labels never train the classifier or calibrate the conformal threshold.
fold_contract.test_use: Evaluation only; never used for normalization, training, calibration, or model selection.
fold_contract.calibration_rotation: For held-out subject index i and repetition r, select eight consecutive subjects from the remaining sorted cohort beginning at offset (i + 7r) mod 32; train on the other 24.

arms.lda_raw: Fixed Experiment 9 regularized LDA trained on pooled raw 54-feature vectors.
arms.lda_subject_robust_normalized: Median-center and IQR-scale each training and calibration subject independently; normalize the held-out subject using only its 16 unlabeled onboarding windows; then fit the identical LDA.

primary_replication_rule.protocol_version_accuracy_change: must be positive in both V1 and V2

interpretation_logic.supported: The representation gate generalizes beyond WESAD to an independent device placement and stress protocol under the frozen effect-size rule.
interpretation_logic.accuracy_only: If accuracy improves but informativeness or coverage conditions fail, baseline correction helps classification but does not validate the complete uncertainty-readiness gate.
interpretation_logic.not_supported: The normalization mechanism remains WESAD-specific or too unstable for the claimed generality under this protocol.

guardrails: This is an independent cohort and device protocol, but not a multi-day repeated-session stress study.
Fifteen-second windows differ from the 60-second WESAD windows because the external protocol contains 26-to-37-second social-stress tasks.
Protocol version is a prespecified cohort-stratification variable.
No hyperparameter search, feature selection, subject exclusion, or decision-rule change is allowed after outcomes are computed.
No literature novelty claim is made.
